Professional Summary
Results-driven Java developer with hands-on experience building backend services and integrations using Java, Spring Boot and Microservices. Experienced in designing and implementing REST APIs, containerized deployments, and event-driven components using Apache Kafka. Strong collaborator with version control and documentation practices.

Technical Skills
Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Apache Kafka, Docker, Hibernate, REST APIs, Confluence, Git

- Developed Kafka-based event pipelines to decouple services for real-time notifications and audit trails, enabling near real-time updates across microservices.
- Containerized services with Docker and standardized deployment images, reducing environment-related defects and accelerating CI/CD iterations.
- Collaborated via Git and documented API contracts and design decisions in Confluence to align cross-functional teams.

Backend Engineer, Ledgerly (May 2023 - Oct 2023)
- Built and maintained REST APIs for transaction reconciliation and ledger queries using Java and Spring Boot, focusing on idempotency and error handling.
- Packaged microservices into Docker containers for consistent staging and production deployments, streamlining release workflows.
- Integrated services with internal event topics to publish change events consumed by downstream analytics, using lightweight messaging patterns.
- Used Git for branching and pull request-based reviews and maintained design notes and runbooks in Confluence.
